description: Makes a campaign step that is not due yet ready now, as Send now on a waiting step does: the campaign writes the message the same way it would on its scheduled day, and it waits in Ready to send. NOTHING sends here; use send_campaign_messages after your person confirms. clientId is the contact (from read campaigns' roster); step is its 0-based step index, and until (YYYY-MM-DD, within 60 days) reschedules it to that day instead. The campaign must be started. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: bring_campaign_step_forward
title: Send a waiting campaign step now
